data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'sibylle', meaning 'prophetess'. Sybil was a name given to the women who were believed to be inspired by the god Apollo and could speak prophecies. In Christian tradition, Sybil is associated with the Sibyls, a group of prophetic women mentioned in the Bible.

in_greek.name: Σύβιλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σύβιλ προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη που σημαίνει 'θεία σοφία' ή 'προφητική'. seo.meta_description: Discover the meaning, origin, and religious significance of the Greek name Sybil, a prophetess name with a rich history in Christianity.
seo.description_paragraph:
The name Sybil is derived from the Greek word 'sibylle', meaning 'prophetess'. In Greek mythology, Sybil was a woman believed to be inspired by the god Apollo to speak prophecies. In Christian tradition, Sybil is associated with the Sibyls, a group of prophetic women mentioned in the Bible.

Sybil's name has endured through centuries due to its strong connection to both Greek mythology and Christianity. Its meaning and significance continue to resonate with people today.
